about.title: Love · Accompany · Move
about.tagline: "Carrying love and goodwill, letting beautiful things pass on."
about.story_p1: After leaving my job, I kept thinking about one thing: so many of my friends are talented and genuine artisans — their work is beautiful — yet they struggle to find buyers simply because they don't know how to market themselves.
about.story_p2: I believe commerce is the greatest form of charity. Without a sustainable model, even the best intentions fade. AiBanXing exists to let beautiful things actually reach the people who will cherish them.
about.story_p3: This isn't just a platform — it's a promise: we only bring in people who are truly trustworthy, and we only share things made with genuine care.
about.layers_title: The four layers we believe in
about.layers_subtitle: From consensus to commerce, every layer matters
about.layer_1_desc: Trust is built on shared understanding — the foundation of everything
about.layer_2_desc: Trust flows between people who know each other
about.layer_3_desc: Genuine endorsements make beautiful things visible
about.layer_4_desc: Commerce sustains the flow of love
about.invite_only_subtitle: This isn't just an invite system — it's a chain of accountability
about.step_1_desc: Only existing members can invite new artisans
about.step_2_desc: Inviters must write a real endorsement, shown permanently on the artisan's profile
about.step_3_desc: The trust chain is preserved in full — every artisan's origin is visible
about.quote: "If you don't trust someone enough, you won't vouch for them. That's the threshold."
about.founder_p1: For many years I wanted to do one thing: accelerate the flow of love. It took me years to figure out how — and leaving my job to finally think it through.
about.founder_p2: AiBanXing isn't a platform — it's a promise. We only bring in people who are truly trustworthy, and we only share things made with genuine care.
about.founder_p3: If you find something beautiful here, share it with someone you trust. That's what love in motion looks like.
about.join_subtitle: Tell us your story — we read every message carefully
about.or_ask_friend: Or find someone already on the platform and ask them to introduce you
